title: What the public repository may carry
ask: Should the repository go private, or stay public with the copyrighted manuals moved out of git, and what licence does its own code carry?
why: The repository github.com/CamdenThomas/Rx7 is public, and it carries about 240 MB of PDFs that are not ours to give away: the Mazda workshop manual sections, the 1982 wiring diagram scan, the parts catalogue, ECUMaster's PMU manual and the TE connector catalogue (sources S-001, S-002, S-005, S-007 - whose own note says 'Mazda copyright, private use'). The free CAD library and the bought 3D model were kept out of git for exactly that reason (D-418); the manuals were not. The same public repository carries your name, your town's junkyards and your words in every decision. The phone reads the record from GitHub without a key today because the repository is public; the fine-grained token it already uses to write reads a private one just as well. A public repository that bundles OFL fonts, MPL Pyodide and MIT code should also say what licence its own code and text are under (02-APP/app/THIRD-PARTY.md lists what is bundled); each option below names the licence choice it comes with, and you can change that part in words. Redistributing others' manuals and choosing a licence are yours to decide.
options:
(a) Make the repository private, and state 'all rights reserved' in a LICENSE file. The manuals stay where they are, the phone keeps working through its token (the token becomes required for reading too), CI keeps running, nothing is rewritten. Nobody outside sees the record; a sponsor showcase would need a separate public face later.
(b) Keep it public, move the manuals and vendor PDFs out of the tree going forward into 01-REFERENCE/model/library/docs/ (already gitignored) with fetch.sh re-fetching the public ones and sources.local_path pointing there, and add a LICENSE (MIT for the tool and app code; the record's text all rights reserved). The past commits still hold the PDFs unless the history is rewritten - a force-push CLAUDE.md forbids without your word; say if you want that too.
(c) Keep it public and leave the manuals in, with no LICENSE file: accept the exposure and leave the licence unstated. Cheapest today.
recommend: (a), unless you want the record readable by anyone for the showcase - then (b), and a history rewrite only if you say so.
stops: Plan steps P51 and P52 (a LICENSE file and moving the manuals); nothing in the build.
